reference_audio.note: Cloning is in-context only: the exact transcript (reference_text) is required alongside the clip.  The engine re-encodes the reference per request (no prompt cache).

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text to synthesize, e.g. 'Hello there'.  Inline paralinguistic tags are supported (Chinese or English): [Breathing], [Cough], [Sigh], [Laughter], [Surprise-ah], [Surprise-oh], [Dissatisfaction-hnn], [Uhm], [Confirmation-en], [Question-ei], [Question-ah], [Question-en], [Question-oh], [Question-huh].

parameters.name: audio_base64
parameters.description: Reference voice sample as a base64 string.  Any container soundfile can decode (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, ...); any input sample rate (the engine resamples).  ~3-10 s of clean speech is the sweet spot.

parameters.name: reference_text
parameters.description: Exact transcript of the reference audio.  Required: cloning is in-context, conditioning on the clip and its transcript together, so the words must match the clip exactly (a wrong transcript degrades the clone).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code (supported: de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, zh); selects the engine cloning task (zh/en: seed, de/es/fr/ja/ko: multilingual).  Omitted or empty defaults to 'en'.  Set it to the language of *text*.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducibility.  If omitted, a random seed in [1, 1000] is chosen and echoed in the response.

parameters.name: cfg_scale
parameters.description: Classifier-free guidance scale.  Engine formal default 2.0.  Must be finite and > 0.

parameters.name: flow_steps
parameters.description: Flow-matching solver steps.  Engine formal default 10; more steps cost time, not quality past that.

parameters.name: sigma
parameters.description: Flow-matching noise scale.  Engine formal default 0.25.  Must be finite and >= 0.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Sampling temperature.  Engine formal default 0.0 (greedy).  Must be finite and >= 0.
